reason: instance, client or service is outside the relying party's accepted carrier configuration
description: Carrier accepted the exchange, but the provider service is not in the relying party's accepted set.

reason: the carrier record carries no message-log reference for both sides of the exchange
description: Carrier accepted the exchange; the record carries no message-log rows for either side.

reason: receipt request digest differs from the carrier record's request payload digest
description: Receipt's request digest differs from the carrier record's request payload digest.

reason: evidence object does not declare a profile this verifier implements
description: Receipt declares a profile this verifier does not implement.

reason: issuer signature does not verify over the canonical payload
description: Receipt payload edited after signing (action summary).

reason: a root endorsement of the issuer key does not verify or does not name the signing key
description: Issuer carries a root endorsement whose payload was altered; the root signature over it no longer verifies.

reason: broker signature does not verify over the envelope payload
description: Broker envelope payload edited after signing (mapping id).

reason: timestamp token does not verify, or does not cover the receipt payload digest
description: Timestamp token payload edited after signing (time).

reason: status list signature does not verify
description: Status list payload edited after signing (issue time).

reason: co-approval does not verify or does not cover the receipt payload digest
description: Co-approval payload edited after signing (approval time).

reason: issuer root is accepted, but not for this action class
description: Partner root is accepted for read and enrich only; the action mutates the case file with scope and co-approval in order.

reason: broker or its mapping id is not registered with the relying party
description: Broker signs with its registered key under a mapping id the relying party has not registered.
